defs.def: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially when they are far apart （尤指长途）旅行，行程verb

ex.s: Daniel and Rachel suggested that Emily continue her journey by train.
ex.t: Daniel和Rachel建议Emily乘火车继续旅程。

ex.s: While farmer’s markets are a solid choice to reduce the journey, Babylon Micro-Farm (BMF) shortens it even more.
ex.t: 虽然农贸市场是缩短路程的不错选择，但Babylon Micro-Farm（BMF）把它缩得更短。

ex.s: As an artist who shares her journey on social media, I’m often asked by curious followers how to begin an art journey.
ex.t: 作为一名在社交媒体上分享自己历程的艺术家，我常被好奇的粉丝问到如何开启艺术之旅。

ex.s: So I’ve put together some good tips for starting an art journey.
ex.t: 因此，我整理了一些开始艺术之旅的好技巧。

ex.s: Let’s get started by checking out Student Guide for your academic journey!
ex.t: 让我们先来看看《学生指南》，开启你的学术之旅吧！

ex.s: In March 2008, Ginni boarded a ship with 48 passengers she’d never met before, to begin the journey towards Antarctica.
ex.t: 2008年3月，金妮与48名素未谋面的乘客登上一艘船，开始了前往南极的旅程。

ex.s: What does Ginni think about Antarctica after the journey?
ex.t: Ginni在旅程结束后如何看待南极洲？

ex.s: The two of them collected more than 1,000 plastic bottles along the 40-day journey.
ex.t: 两人在40天的旅途中收集了1000多个塑料瓶。

ex.s: are in high spirits after their journeys
ex.t: 旅程后士气高涨

ex.s: Science: Endless Journey to Truth
ex.t: 科学：通往真理的无尽旅程

ex.s: He documented his journey as he set about treating nature as a brand to be marketed to young people.
ex.t: 他记录了自己的历程，开始把大自然当作一个面向年轻人推广的品牌来经营。

ex.s: Journey Back in Time with Scholars
ex.t: 与学者一起穿越时空之旅

ex.s: Journey through the beautiful countryside of Provence，France，with Prof Ori Z.
ex.t: 与Ori Z教授一起穿越法国普罗旺斯美丽的乡村。

ex.s: Our journey takes us to picturesque Berber villages and lovely beaches.
ex.t: 我们的旅程将带我们前往风景如画的柏柏尔村庄和美丽的海滩。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: Journeys into the wilderness.
ex.t: 它的多样化功能。

ex.s: （4）Why do the hikers take no notice of the surroundings during the journey？
ex.t: （4）为什么徒步者在旅途期间对周围的环境毫不在意？

ex.s: They tolerate long, slow journeys to and from work on packed highways because they can work, entertain themselves or sleep on the ride, which encourages urban spread.
ex.t: 他们忍受在拥挤的高速公路上漫长而缓慢的上下班通勤，因为他们可以在途中工作、娱乐或睡觉，这促进了城市扩张。

ex.s: Every autumn, millions of these beautiful insects with fine black and orange wings begin a long and difficult journey.
ex.t: 每年秋天，数以百万计这些长着黑橙相间美丽翅膀的昆虫开始一段漫长而艰难的旅程。

ex.s: There is no doubt that the Bernina Express is a journey for travellers who want to get back to nature: the train window becomes the TV screen, and the natural world is the show.
ex.t: 毫无疑问，贝尔尼纳快车是为想要回归自然的旅行者准备的旅程：火车窗户变成了电视屏幕，自然界就是节目。

ex.s: So, we're now in Newfoundland, the very eastern part of Canada and the end of out journey.
ex.t: 所以，我们现在在纽芬兰，加拿大的最东部，也是我们旅程的终点。

ex.s: Your next destination: the Antarctic, to journey to the South Pole.
ex.t: 你的下一个目的地：南极洲，前往南极点之旅。

ex.s: Modern English still used the word “odyssey” to describe an epic voyage or journey.
ex.t: 现代英语仍然使用odyssey这个词来描述一次史诗般的航程或旅程。
